content:
CNN chief data analyst Harry Enten on Thursday broke down the staggering collapse in support for Donald Trump among voters under the age of 25.

On “News Central,” Enten described it as “a historic shift,” punctuating his analysis with his signature “my goodness gracious” catchphrase.

House Democrats won the youth vote by 14 percentage points in 2024, he noted. In this year’s midterms, that margin soared to 56 points.

“That is wild,” said anchor Kate Bolduan.

“It’s a huge shift,” agreed Enten.

Bolduan noted that the astonishing 42-point swing hadn’t taken place gradually over 20 years, but in just two.

“Oh, my God,” said Enten, who attributed the drastic turnaround to Trump.

The president won 43% of the vote from people under 25 in 2024, but his approval rating among that age group has now plummeted to just 15%, he said.

“This drove a historic shift away from the Republicans to the Democrats. It is this gentleman on your screen right here. They, simply put, despise the president of the United States,” Enten added.
